title: LiveMirror: Real-Time Diffusion Virtual Try-On on a Consumer GPU and Its Self-Supervised Adaptation to Indian Ethnic Wear
abstract: arXiv:2611.30461v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion virtual try-on (VTO) models produce convincing garment transfers from a single product photograph, but at hundreds of milliseconds to seconds per image every deployment today is offline or falls back to AR mirrors that need a rigged 3D asset per product. We present LiveMirror, a live-camera try-on mirror that renders a flat garment photograph onto a moving person with a diffusion model on one 16 GB consumer GPU. Its core is asynchronous keyframe try-on: generation never blocks the display, every displayed frame is an optical-flow warp of the latest generated keyframe, and keyframes are replaced only through a cross-fade. The display runs at camera rate (25 FPS at 720p) while a new try-on arrives every 370-490 ms; we measure the residual flicker, give a stage-by-stage latency budget, and report which accelerations (step count, consistency LoRA, tiny decoder, compilation) keep garment prints intact. translated_title: LiveMirror：基于消费级GPU的实时扩散模型虚拟试衣及其对印度民族服饰的自监督适应
translated_abstract: 扩散虚拟试衣（VTO）模型能够仅凭一张商品照片生成令人信服的服装迁移效果，但由于每张图像的生成需要数百毫秒至数秒，目前所有部署方案要么只能离线运行，要么退而求其次使用需要为每件商品预先制作绑定3D资产的AR试衣镜。我们提出了LiveMirror，一个实时摄像头试衣镜系统，它能在单块16 GB消费级GPU上，使用扩散模型将平面的服装照片渲染到移动的人身上。其核心是异步关键帧试衣机制：生成过程从不阻塞显示，每一显示帧都是对最新生成关键帧的光流变形，且关键帧仅通过交叉淡入淡出的方式替换。显示以摄像头帧率运行（720p下25 FPS），同时每370-490毫秒产出一帧新的试穿结果；我们测量了残留闪烁程度，给出了逐阶段的延迟预算，并报告了哪些加速手段（步数缩减、一致性LoRA、微型解码器、编译优化）能在提速的同时保持服装印花完好无损。随后我们展示了相同G……
tldr: 提出LiveMirror系统，通过异步关键帧生成、光流变形与交叉淡入淡出机制，在单块16GB消费级GPU上实现了25 FPS实时显示的扩散模型虚拟试衣镜，并可通过自监督学习适应印度民族服饰。
